description: Portfolio state and limits from ControllerDiagnostics.

options.content:
**Source:** `ControllerDiagnostics.state`, `risk.exposure_*`, and `risk.limits`.

Inventory/cash use normalized wallet totals (`free + locked`). Net-delta risk exposure shows ledger locked collateral vs target-book locked collateral per venue.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'local_inventory' AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT e.ts, 'global_inventory',
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'local_marked' AS metric,
  COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_wealth'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_wealth'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_cash'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_cash'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END
     + CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END
       * COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
UNION ALL
SELECT e.ts, 'global_marked',
  COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_wealth'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_wealth'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_cash'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_cash'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END
     + CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END
       * COALESCE(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_sell_vwap'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_quote_wallet', leg], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_quote_wallet', leg], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES ('free', 'free'), ('locked', 'locked'), ('total', 'total')
) AS legs(metric, leg)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_base_wallet', leg], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_base_wallet', leg], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES ('free', 'free'), ('locked', 'locked'), ('total', 'total')
) AS legs(metric, leg)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", lim AS metric, v AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  VALUES
    ('min', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['risk','limits','local','min_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['risk','limits','local','min_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END),
    ('max', CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['risk','limits','local','max_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['risk','limits','local','max_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
) AS t(lim, v)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND v IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", 'local_plus_global' AS metric,
  (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','local_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END
   + CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_inventory'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_quote_wallet', leg], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_quote_wallet', leg], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES ('free', 'free'), ('locked', 'locked'), ('total', 'total')
) AS legs(metric, leg)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_base_wallet', leg], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','global_base_wallet', leg], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES ('free', 'free'), ('locked', 'locked'), ('total', 'total')
) AS legs(metric, leg)
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'risk'->'exposure_before', '{}'::jsonb)
) AS kv
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND kv.key LIKE '%locked%'
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(e.payload->'risk'->'exposure_after', '{}'::jsonb)
) AS kv
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND (kv.key LIKE '%locked%' OR kv.key LIKE 'consolidated_%')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage || '_' || key AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> exposure_path, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> exposure_path, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES
    ('before', 'consolidated_base_inventory'),
    ('before', 'consolidated_quote_wealth'),
    ('after', 'consolidated_base_inventory'),
    ('after', 'consolidated_quote_wealth')
) AS legs(stage, key)
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ARRAY['risk', 'exposure_' || stage, key] AS exposure_path
) AS paths
WHERE 
  e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.symbol = '${symbol}'
  AND e.actor_id = '${actor_id}'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> exposure_path IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1
